rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking carefully about something.

example.english: I’ll mull over this when I get home.
example.traditional: 呢件事我返到屋企再諗。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zoi3 nam2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that you keep thinking about something repeatedly or at length.

example.english: I had to mull over this decision for several nights.
example.traditional: 呢個決定我反覆諗咗幾晚。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ngo5 faan2 fuk1 nam2 zo2 gei2 maan5

rows.note: Use this especially when weighing a decision, option, or course of action.

example.english: Ming is still trying to mull over whether to change jobs or stay.
example.traditional: 阿明仲喺度考慮轉工定留低。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 zung6 hai2 dou6 haau2 leoi6 zyun3 gung1 ding6 lau4 dai1
